jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres Teams am Standort in Grödig bei Salzburg und setze dein Talent und deine Leidenschaft bei uns ein als

Project Manager Manufacturing & Design Transfer (w/m/d)

Grödig, Salzburg

Dein Beitrag

In dieser spannenden Funktion leitest Du Optimierungsprojekte innerhalb der Fertigung inkl. In/Outsourcing, begleitest die Überleitung neuer Produkte in die Serie und unterstützt beim Transfer von Produkten innerhalb des Tecan Produktionsnetzwerkes

• Koordination und Abstimmung zwischen Produktion, Entwicklung, Engineering und Projektteams

• Erstellung und Überwachung des Zeitplans für den Projekttransfer

• Planung der Produktionsvalidierung

• Einbringung produktionsrelevanter Themen ins Projekt

• Erstellung von Prozessbeschreibungen und Arbeitsanweisungen

• Risikobetrachtung des Produktionsprozesses

• Leitung von Optimierungsprojekten in Operations

• Unterstützung bei In/Outsourcing Projekten

• Unterstützung bei der Planung der Produktionslinien unter Einhaltung der Lean und 5S-Prinzipien.

Dein Profil

Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Lehre mit Meister, HTL, FH oder  vergleichbar) im Bereich Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung

• Berufserfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, Design Transfer, Industrial Engineering oder Manufacturing Engineering.

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement

• Grundwissen in den Bereichen Elektronik, Firmware, Optik, Mechanik

• Kenntnisse im Lean-Management von Vorteil

• Organisationstalent, analytisches Denken und hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

Bei Tecan arbeitest du an Technologien, die weltweit in Forschung, Diagnostik und Gesundheitswesen eingesetzt werden. Dich erwartet ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ausgezeichneten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Freue dich auf:

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum

• Mitarbeit in einem international erfolgreichen Hightech-Unternehmen

• Spannende Technologien im Bereich Life Science und Medizintechnik

• Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

• Sehr gute öffentliche Anbindung und kostenlose Parkplätze

• Betriebskantine

• Umfangreiche Benefits zur Auswahl, wie JobRad, Klimaticket, Zukunfts-vorsorge, eGYM Wellpass, Lebensmittelzuschuss, Firmenveranstaltungen und vieles mehr.

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work!  Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren  Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto und ohne Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse und Diplome sind optional).

Dein Ansprechpartner:

Albert Gamper (Head HR Tecan Austria)

T +43 6246 8933 277

albert.gamper@tecan.com

Aufgrund des österreichischen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes sind wir verpflichtet, das für diese Position vorgesehene monatliche  Mindestgehalt  von  EUR 3.888,53  (Einstufung laut Kollektivvertrag der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie  auf Basis Vollzeit 38,5 Stunden/Woche ) als Verhandlungsbasis anzugeben.  Eine deutliche Überzahlung ist je nach Ausbildung, Qualifikation und Erfahrung vorgesehen.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #DesignTransfer #Projektleitung #Operations #Validierung

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Entra a far parte del nostro team nella posizione di Grödig vicino a Salisburgo e usa il tuo talento e la tua passione con noi come

Project Manager Manufacturing & Design Transfer (m/f/d)

Grödig, Salisburgo

Il tuo contributo

In questa funzione emozionante si guida progetti di ottimizzazione all'interno della produzione incl. In/outsourcing, accompagnare il trasferimento di nuovi prodotti in serie e sostenere il trasferimento di prodotti all'interno della rete di produzione Tecan

• Coordinamento e coordinamento tra team di produzione, sviluppo, ingegneria e progetto

• Preparazione e monitoraggio del programma di trasferimento del progetto

• Pianificazione della convalida di produzione

• Introdurre argomenti rilevanti per la produzione nel progetto

• Preparazione di descrizioni di processo e istruzioni di lavoro

• Valutazione del rischio del processo di produzione

• Gestione dei progetti di ottimizzazione nelle operazioni

• Sostegno a progetti in/outsourcing

• Sostegno alla pianificazione delle linee di produzione nel rispetto dei principi Lean e 5S.

Il tuo profilo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di competenze: stiamo cercando persone che possano mettere la loro passione e talento a lavorare con noi.

• Formazione tecnica completa (insegnamento con master, HTL, FH o simili) nel campo della meccatronica, ingegneria meccanica, tecnologia medica o una specializzazione relativa

• Esperienza professionale nella gestione dei progetti tecnici, trasferimento di design, ingegneria industriale o ingegneria manifatturiera.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti

• Conoscenza di base in elettronica, firmware, ottica, meccanica

• La conoscenza della gestione magra è un vantaggio

• Talenti organizzativi, pensiero analitico e consapevolezza di alta qualità

• Buona SM Conoscenza degli uffici, conoscenza SAP dei vantaggi

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

A Tecan, lavori sulle tecnologie utilizzate nella ricerca, nella diagnostica e nella sanità in tutto il mondo. Si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno con un sacco di strada creativa e eccellenti opportunità di sviluppo.

Attendere con ansia:

• Una posizione responsabile con molto spazio per manovra

• Lavorare in un'azienda high-tech di successo internazionale

• Tecnologie emozionanti nel campo della scienza della vita e della tecnologia medica

• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali

• Orari di lavoro flessibili e opzioni per l'ufficio domestico

• Ottimo accesso pubblico e parcheggio gratuito

• Servizio mensa

• Ampia gamma di vantaggi tra cui scegliere, come JobRad, ticket climatici, fornitura futura, eGYM Wellpass, sussidio alimentare, eventi aziendali e molto altro ancora.

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui puoi saperne di più sulla nostra certificazione Great Place to Work.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

La persona di contatto:

Albert Gamper (Head HR Tecan Austria)

T +43 6246 8933 277

albert.gamper@tecan.com

A causa della legge austriaca sulla parità di trattamento, siamo tenuti a specificare lo stipendio minimo mensile di EUR 3.888.53 (classificazione secondo l'accordo collettivo dell'industria elettrica ed elettronica su una base a tempo pieno di 38.5 ore/settimana) come base per i negoziati. Si prevede un pagamento eccessivo significativo a seconda dell'istruzione, delle qualifiche e dell'esperienza.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #DesignTransfer #project management #Operations #Validation

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

Avez-vous déjà demandé comment vos compétences et vos antécédents uniques peuvent affecter le monde de demain? Faites partie de notre équipe à l'emplacement de Grödig près de Salzbourg et utilisez votre talent et votre passion avec nous comme

Gestionnaire de projet Fabrication et conception Transfert (h/f/d)

Grödig, Salzbourg

Votre contribution

Dans cette fonction passionnante vous dirigez des projets d'optimisation dans la production incl. Accompagner le transfert de nouveaux produits en série et soutenir le transfert de produits au sein du réseau de production Tecan

• Coordination et coordination entre les équipes de production, de développement, d'ingénierie et de projet

• Préparation et suivi du calendrier de transfert du projet

• Planification de la validation de la production

• Introduction de sujets pertinents pour la production dans le projet

• Préparation des descriptions de processus et des instructions de travail

• Évaluation des risques du processus de production

• Gestion des projets d'optimisation dans les opérations

• Appui aux projets d ' externalisation

• Appui à la planification des lignes de production conformément aux principes Lean et 5S.

Votre profil

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement l'expertise: nous cherchons des gens qui peuvent mettre leur passion et leur talent à notre service.

• Formation technique complète (enseignement avec master, HTL, FH ou similaire) dans le domaine de la mécatronique, de l'ingénierie mécanique, de la technologie médicale ou d'une spécialisation connexe

• Expérience professionnelle en gestion de projet technique, transfert de conception, ingénierie industrielle ou ingénierie de fabrication.

• Expérience en gestion de projet

• Connaissances de base en électronique, firmware, optique, mécanique

• La connaissance de la gestion maigre est un avantage

• Compétences organisationnelles, réflexion analytique et sensibilisation de haute qualité

• Bonne EM Connaissance des bureaux, connaissance SAP des avantages

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais

Qu'est-ce qui rend le travail à Tecan unique?

Chez Tecan, vous travaillez sur les technologies utilisées dans la recherche, le diagnostic et les soins de santé dans le monde entier. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne avec beaucoup de latitude créative et d'excellentes opportunités de développement.

Nous attendons avec impatience:

• Une position responsable avec beaucoup de marge de manoeuvre

• Travailler dans une entreprise de haute technologie ayant un succès international

• Technologies passionnantes dans le domaine des sciences de la vie et des technologies médicales

• Possibilités individuelles de formation et de perfectionnement

• Horaires de travail flexibles et options de bureau à domicile

• Très bon accès public et parking gratuit

• Service cantine

• De nombreux avantages à choisir, comme JobRad, billet climat, provision future, eGYM Wellpass, subvention alimentaire, événements corporatifs et bien plus encore.

Devenez membre de Tecan, certifié Great Place to Work! Ici vous pouvez en savoir plus sur notre certification Great Place to Work.

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature en ligne. Pour votre candidature, nous n'avons besoin que de votre CV (sans photo et sans lettres de motivation, les certificats et diplômes sont facultatifs).

Votre personne-ressource:

Albert Gamper (chef HR Tecan Autriche)

T +43 6246 8933 277

Albert.gamper@tecan.com

En raison de la loi autrichienne sur l'égalité de traitement, nous sommes tenus de préciser le salaire mensuel minimum de 3 888,53 EUR (classification selon la convention collective de l'industrie électrique et électronique à temps plein de 38,5 heures/semaine) comme base de négociation. Un trop-payé important est envisagé en fonction de l'éducation, des qualifications et de l'expérience.

#sciences de la vie #santé #automation #médicaldevice #biologie #biotechnologie #DesignTransfert #gestion de projet #Opérations #Validation

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.title: HR Intern
jobs.description:
Human Resources Intern

Location: Morrisville, North Carolina

Position Summary

Tecan is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Human Resources Intern to join our People & Organization team in Morrisville, NC. This internship provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience while supporting the day-to-day operations of the HR team and contributing to projects that enhance the employee experience and organizational effectiveness.

Working alongside members of the People & Organization team, the intern will support a variety of HR activities and projects while gaining exposure to multiple Human Resources disciplines based on business priorities and organizational needs. This opportunity is ideal for students or individuals interested in exploring careers in Human Resources, business administration, or people management while developing practical business skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Example Projects

Depending on business priorities during the internship, opportunities may include:

• Supporting onboarding and new hire orientation activities

• Assisting with employee records management and HR documentation

• Creating and maintaining HR templates, forms, and electronic documents

• Supporting interview scheduling and recruiting coordination

• Assisting with employee engagement and recognition initiatives

• Preparing HR reports, presentations, and process documentation

Essential Responsibilities

Human Resources Operations

• Assist with onboarding and new hire orientation activities.

• Support employee record maintenance while ensuring confidentiality of sensitive information.

• Assist with HR data entry, audits, and document management.

• Prepare HR reports, spreadsheets, and presentations as needed.

• Assist with creating and maintaining HR templates, forms, process documentation, and fillable electronic forms.

Talent Acquisition

• Assist with interview scheduling and candidate communications.

• Coordinate interview logistics and recruiting activities.

• Participate in résumé screening and other recruitment support activities.

Employee Engagement

• Assist with employee engagement initiatives and recognition programs.

• Support employee events, wellness activities, and community engagement initiatives.

• Help prepare communications and presentation materials for HR activities.

Qualifications

Required

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

• Human Resources

• Business Administration

• Management

• Psychology

• Organizational Leadership

• Or a related field

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Preferred

• Previous internship, administrative, or customer service experience.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or HR information systems.

• Interest in Human Resources, talent acquisition, employee engagement, or organizational development.

Competencies

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Organization and attention to detail

• Professionalism and integrity

• Learning agility

• Initiative

• Collaboration and teamwork

• Customer service orientation

• Adaptability

• Continuous improvement mindset

Learning Opportunities

This internship is designed to provide a balance of meaningful project work and hands-on learning opportunities. While supporting the day-to-day activities of the People & Organization team, the selected candidate will gain exposure to HR operations, onboarding, talent acquisition, employee engagement, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration. The specific projects will vary based on business needs during the internship, providing practical experience and insight into how Human Resources supports organizational success.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in an office environment.

• Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods.

• Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Why Join Tecan?

jobs.description:
Mechanical Assembler

Onsite – Morgan Hill, CA  95037

Schedule: Day Shift (7AM-3:30PM)
Full-Time | Non-Exempt
Salary Range: $21-$23HRLY DOE

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about precision, quality, and hands-on work? Join our team as a Mechanical Assembler, where you will play a key role in building high-quality assemblies that support life science and healthcare innovation.

In this role, you will assemble mechanical components with accuracy and consistency while collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet production and quality goals. You will also gain exposure to continuous improvement initiatives and advanced manufacturing processes.

If you are detail-oriented, collaborative, and results-driven, we invite you to bring your expertise to our growing team.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Build mechanical assemblies with strict adherence to established processes and vPoke® principles

• Ensure components are properly handled, inspected, and installed with precision

• Cross-train to support multiple functions across the mechanical production floor and other departments

• Partner with production supervisors and team members to meet output and quality targets

• Follow all safety, quality, and company compliance standards

• Support process improvement initiatives and team-based projects

• Maintain accurate work practices in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What You Bring

• Basic mechanical assembly skills; prior experience preferred

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions and procedures

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Effective verbal and written communication skills in English

• Positive attitude and strong teamwork mindset

• Flexibility to work extended hours based on business needs

Your Background

• High school diploma or equivalent experience

• Experience in mechanical assembly or use of basic hand tools

• Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment

• Familiarity with workplace safety standards

Nice to Have

Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 30 lbs

• Ability to stand, bend, and perform repetitive tasks throughout the shift

What We Offer

• Medical, Dental, and Vision effective on your first day

• 16 company-paid holidays

• 401(k) employer match on first 6% contributions (no vesting period)

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• HSA & HRA options

• Company-paid short- and long-term disability

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity coverage

• Legal Shield / Identity Shield

• Discounted Pet Insurance

Salary range: $21/HR– $23/HR
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

jobs.title: Field Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Field Sales Engineer (Mid-West)

Remote

Position Overview

Our LSB Detection Sales Engineer is responsible for selling the Tecan Spark, Infinite 200 and Hydrospeed plate washer product lines and corresponding service contracts within the defined territory as well as Veya & Duo/Uno products in University and Government accounts specifically.  His/her primary roles are to ensure that their sales objectives are met or exceeded within acceptable profit goals. He/she will also work directly with existing & new customers to identify their needs, understand their application methodology and apply this knowledge to offer a Tecan solution. This role will cover the Mid-West territory.

Essential Responsibilities

•
 Responsible for all aspects of the local sale including but not limited to; prospecting, lead generation and follow-up, quotations, demonstrations, negotiations, contracts, terms and conditions, closing, and through the installation and post-sale support process.

•
 Serves as a responsible representative of Tecan US, Inc. and operates with integrity and honesty in all business contacts.

•
 Achieves sales plan for assigned territory.

•
 Develops and maintains a high level of consultative sales skills, product and application methodology knowledge with associated features and benefits required to convert customer needs to sales.

•
 Obtains sufficient knowledge of accounts in order to develop and maintain account strategies to convert specific company needs to Tecan solutions.

•
 Develops and maintains effective time, territory, and account management practices.

•
 Responsible for providing regular and accurate forecast information for the territory in the CRM.

•
 Participates in or supports local, regional and national shows, as requested.

•
 Conducts demonstrations and coordinates installations and customer training.

•
 Builds relationships with procurement departments to streamline the approval processes.

•
 Adjusts content of sales presentations (within the guidelines of regulatory) by understanding the customers’ explicit and implied needs.

•
 Complies with regulatory requirements for appropriate Market & Business Units.

•
 Maintains accurate and timely data in the CRM.

•
 Responds to problems or complaints that arise in accounts, either by personal action or by securing the assistance and support from others in the organization.

•
 Works as a liaison for reporting customer complaints to Tecan Technical Services and making recommendations to management.

•
 Works regularly with the Service organization to insure customer satisfaction and to realize revenue on a predictable and timely manner.

•
 Appropriately manages existing accounts and establishes new accounts and customers by planning and organizing daily work schedule to call on existing or potential sales opportunities.

•
 Maintains all company supplied equipment and material in a safe, useable and serviceable condition.

•
 Completes all reports and customer information effectively and consistently as deemed necessary by the company

•
 Gives feedback to management regarding new potential applications or competition in the marketplace

•
 Ability to travel (often on short notice).

•
 Handles essential tasks as assigned, and responds to change productively.

•
 Follows all local safety procedures, State and Federal OSHA Regulations, and reports any safety concerns

What you will bring

•
 Ability to manage and develop sales territories while also managing costs and risks

•
 Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail

•
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills to be able to explain both technical and non-technical topics

•
 Strong presentation skills demonstrated before customers, peers, and upper management

•
 Ability to recognize and manage potential problem areas and resolve them with integrity

•
 Ability to understand the needs of clients and co-workers

•
 Must be self-motivated, resourceful and adaptable

•
 Ability to collaborate with others by being a good listener, a team builder, and an articulate advocate of the vision

•
 Ability to travel, at times on short notice

•
 Ability to prioritize and effectively complete necessary tasks in the time required

•
 High level of commitment and initiative

•
 Proven team player

•
 Ability to accept constructive feedback

•
 Possess a valid driver's license

What makes working at Tecan unique?

•
 The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

•
 Working in an international and diverse environment

•
 The chance to grow your career within the company

•
 Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

Benefits :

•
 Medical, Dental, and Vision

•
 Health Reimbursement Account

•
 401(k) Employer match on employee's first 6% contributions; no vesting period

•
 Long/Short-term disability insurance

•
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

•
 Accident, Critical Illness, & Hospital Indemnity

•
 Legal Shield/Identity Shield

•
 Discounted Pet Insurance

Salary range: $100K-$120K base plus bonus.

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Advertisement Template English

Join Tecan! Join the market leader!
Work in an international and dynamic environment, share our success!

Do you want to make a significant difference in how the world is looking tomorrow and contribute to the innovation of state-of-the-art, cutting-edge technology products?
Then look no further and join our Marketing team at Shanghai, Area as
Product Specialist

What you will do
The owner of the role to ensure implementation of processes for innovation management in marketing team

Responsibilities will include

1.Contribute to KOL identification and maintaining a KOL network for the selected applications with sales team
2.Contribute to new products &solution ideas collections and screening for corporate product development
3.Contribute to the evaluation of business and market potential for new solution ideas
4.Contribute to the evaluation of buy-in, licensing and partnership opportunities for the technologies
5.Contribute to the defining and maintaining of product &solution portfolio and define study and development projects orders
6.Contribute to the alignment if product/solution portfolio with resources available ,check external development options
7.Provide product care management for applications &solutions, with lifecycle management, customer li-aision,define engineering change order
8.Manage phase out of applications &solutions

Product lifecycle management
1.Monitor and analyze competitor products
2.Manage and provide all necessary documentation according to the actual product development process
3.Travel with the sales force to visit key customers.
4.Develop new product applications/protocols with customers and outside partners
5.Support regions with product specific application or technical information
6.Develop sales argument and pitfalls for competition
7.Monitor customer needs and ensure product still fulfills them
8.Identify BOL’S to propose product extensions or new product ideas and give guidance to marketing manager
9.Provide and update marketing and technical literature to support product
10.Optimize product portfolio for assigned product (reductions,deletions,changes)
11.Share/consolidate product feedback information with Marketing and other business managers

Implementation off the annual Tactical Marketing Plan
1.Derive form the marketing strategy an annual tactical marketing plan including all marketing talks etc.in co-operation with Marcom and Sales for assigned applications
2.Coordinate and manage local marketing activities according to the marketing plan
3.Ensure that the planned tactical activities fit within budget allocations and monitoring the ROMI(return on marketing investment)of the activities
4.Analyze the Plan in a quarterly basis and amend where necessary
5.Support sales, marketing and service activities
6.Produce marketing and technical literature on time and in budget together the Marcom group

What you bring along
Bachelor in Biology or life sciences
Min. 3 years related working experience
Good written and verbal English skills
Basic Local Language Knowledge
Negotiation and Analytical skills
Knowledge of Business processes

What you will get
•    Comprehensive Compensation and Benefits package
•    Progressive employment conditions
•    Exciting career opportunities
•    Wide range of training courses
•    International and diverse environment (30+ different nationalities)
•    Strong company culture with rich history
•    Global mindset with “Swissness” at heart

Look no further and apply now!
We are looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

We will only consider applications that fully meet our requirements.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medical device #biology #biotechnology  # etc.

We care about people - Join the market leader.
People every day all around the world will benefit from more personalized healthcare. The promise of better, faster, more cost efficient solutions is now within our grasp. And that’s the world in which Tecan plays a vital role – helping advance healthcare – through advanced life science research and diagnostic solutions. We constantly seek new ways to steer innovation.

Every lab. Every day. Empowered.
Our vision is to empower every laboratory, every day, around the world with Tecan technology, products and support. We will help to shape the future of automated workflows in life sciences and clinical diagnostics through unrivaled expertise, products and customer support.

We care about our culture.
Our values – trust, highest standards and ambition – are the cornerstones of our business, and give us the framework for the Tecan culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment, which allows us to bring our passion and energy to work. This helps us to deliver on our customer promise – ‘Always there for you’.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Template Italiano

Unisciti a Tecan! Unisciti al leader del mercato!
Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e dinamico, condividere il nostro successo!

Vuoi fare una significativa differenza nel modo in cui il mondo sta guardando domani e contribuire all'innovazione dei prodotti tecnologici all'avanguardia e all'avanguardia?
Quindi non guardare oltre e unire il nostro team di Marketing a Shanghai, Area come
Specialista del prodotto

Cosa farai
Il titolare del ruolo di garantire l'implementazione dei processi per la gestione dell'innovazione nel team di marketing

Le responsabilità includono

1.Contribuire all'identificazione KOL e mantenere una rete KOL per le applicazioni selezionate con il team di vendita
2.Contribuire a nuovi prodotti &solution idee collezioni e screening per lo sviluppo di prodotti aziendali
3.Contribuire alla valutazione del potenziale di business e di mercato per nuove idee di soluzione
4.Contribuire alla valutazione delle opportunità di buy-in, licensing e partnership per le tecnologie
5.Contribuire alla definizione e al mantenimento del portafoglio di prodotti e soluzioni e definire gli ordini di progetti di studio e sviluppo
6.Contribuire all'allineamento se portafoglio prodotti/soluzione con risorse disponibili , controllare le opzioni di sviluppo esterno
7. Fornire la gestione della cura del prodotto per applicazioni e soluzioni, con la gestione del ciclo di vita, cliente li-aision, definire l'ordine di cambiamento di ingegneria
8.La fase di gestione delle applicazioni e delle soluzioni

Gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto
1.Monitor e analizzare i prodotti concorrenti
2.Manage e fornire tutta la documentazione necessaria secondo il processo di sviluppo del prodotto effettivo
3.Travel con la forza di vendita per visitare i clienti chiave.
4.Sviluppare nuove applicazioni/protocolli di prodotto con clienti e partner esterni
5. Regioni di sostegno con applicazione specifica del prodotto o informazioni tecniche
6.Sviluppi argomenti di vendita e insidie per la concorrenza
7.Monitor esigenze del cliente e garantire il prodotto ancora li soddisfa
8.Identificare BOL’S per proporre estensioni di prodotto o nuove idee di prodotto e dare indicazioni al marketing manager
9.Providere e aggiornare la letteratura di marketing e tecnica per supportare il prodotto
10.Ottimizzare il portafoglio prodotti per il prodotto assegnato (riduzione,delezioni,cambiamenti)
11.Share/consolidare le informazioni di feedback dei prodotti con Marketing e altri business manager

Attuazione del Piano di Marketing Tattico annuale
1.Derive forma la strategia di marketing un piano di marketing tattico annuale, inclusi tutti i colloqui di marketing ecc.in cooperazione con Marcom e Vendite per le applicazioni assegnate
2.Coordinare e gestire le attività di marketing locale secondo il piano di marketing
3. Assicurarsi che le attività tattiche previste si adattano alle allocazioni di bilancio e monitorano la ROMI (ritorno agli investimenti di marketing) delle attività
4.Analizzare il Piano in una base trimestrale e modificare se necessario
5. Sostenere le attività di vendita, marketing e servizi
6.Produrre marketing e letteratura tecnica nel tempo e nel bilancio insieme al gruppo Marcom

Che cosa porta
Corso di laurea in biologia o scienze della vita
Min. 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa
Buone competenze scritte e verbali
Conoscenza della lingua locale di base
Negoziazione e competenze analitiche
Conoscenza dei processi aziendali

Ciò che otterrà
•    Pacchetto Compensazione e benefici completi
•    Condizioni di occupazione progressiva
•    Eccitanti opportunità di carriera
•    Ampia gamma di corsi di formazione
•    Ambiente internazionale e diversificato (30+ nazionalità diverse)
•    Forte cultura aziendale con ricca storia
•    Mindset globale con “Svizzera” a cuore

Non guardare oltre e applicare ora!
Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il vostro curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di copertura, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Considereremo solo applicazioni che soddisfano pienamente le nostre esigenze.

Join our Legal team and shape your career on a global stage.

Contract Manager 80-100%

Barcelona, Spain

Your contribution

As Contract Manager, you will ensure efficient, risk-aware, and business-focused legal operations for all Tecan affiliates worldwide. Reporting to the Director of Legal Affairs, you will:

• Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of standardized contracts for all Group affiliates worldwide, including confidentiality agreements, terms & conditions, procurement, consultancy, co-marketing, beta testing, and key opinion leader agreements

• Provide general legal support as required

• Provide training to employees on legal matters

• Collaborate with colleagues in Legal Affairs and business stakeholders across the globe to ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. We welcome recent graduates as well as professionals with initial practical experience who are eager to build their career in international contract management. You bring:

• A bachelor’s degree in law

• Initial exposure to drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in English and German, or strong motivation to develop these skills

• Knowledge of international contracts and the ability to navigate cross-border legal challenges

• Fluency in English and German (both written and spoken)

• A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset with the confidence to support stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and cultures

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

• You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We look forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (without picture and without cover letter; reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #lawyer #legal #law

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100%)

Männedorf, Switzerland (with extensive travel across EMEA)

Your contribution

As the Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA, you will play a key role in driving Tecan’s growth across the EMEA region. You will be responsible for building and managing a high-performing distributor network, ensuring our partners are empowered to deliver advanced laboratory automation solutions to customers in life sciences, applied markets, and clinical diagnostics. By acting as a strategic link between market needs and Tecan’s internal teams, you will help shape business development and product innovation. Your efforts will ensure the successful positioning and adoption of complex technical solutions, while fostering strong, self-sufficient distributor relationships that support Tecan’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

• Lead the recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of distributor partners across EMEA.

• Develop and execute strategic business plans with each distributor, ensuring alignment with Tecan’s growth objectives.

• Own the full sales cycle—from opportunity generation to project delivery—acting as the primary interface between distribution partners and internal stakeholders.

• Support distributors in customer engagement, including joint visits, presentations, and negotiations.

• Monitor distributor performance, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement of sales performance and profitability.

• Provide technical expertise in laboratory automation, instrument configuration, and integrated solutions.

• Deliver high-level technical presentations and participate in key customer discussions.

• Coordinate cross-functional internal stakeholders to ensure successful execution of complex and high-value projects.

• Travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region to support distributor and customer needs.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in technical or natural sciences (molecular biology, physics, engineering, or related fields).

• 5+ years’ experience in life sciences, diagnostics, or laboratory automation, with hands-on exposure to complex lab instruments or automation platforms.

• Proven track record managing or working with distributor networks (ideally across EMEA).

• Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, applications, and customer environments.

• Excellent communication skills in English; French, German, or Arabic are a plus.

• Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50–70%) across the EMEA region.

• Strategic mindset, resilience, agility, and a collaborative approach to influencing without direct authority.

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera (con un ampio viaggio attraverso EMEA)

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella guida della crescita di Tecan nella regione EMEA. Sarete responsabili della costruzione e della gestione di una rete di distributori altamente performante, garantendo ai nostri partner il potere di fornire soluzioni avanzate di automazione di laboratorio ai clienti nelle scienze della vita, nei mercati applicati e nella diagnostica clinica. Agendo come un collegamento strategico tra le esigenze del mercato e i team interni di Tecan, contribuirai a modellare lo sviluppo aziendale e l’innovazione dei prodotti. I vostri sforzi garantiranno il posizionamento e l'adozione di soluzioni tecniche complesse, promuovendo al contempo forti relazioni di distribuzione autosufficienti che sostengono la reputazione di Tecan per l'eccellenza e la soddisfazione del cliente.

responsabilità

• Condurre il reclutamento, l'imbarco e la gestione continua delle prestazioni dei partner distributori in EMEA.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire piani di business strategici con ogni distributore, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi di crescita di Tecan.

• Proprio il ciclo di vendita completo — dalla generazione di opportunità alla consegna di progetti — che agisce come l'interfaccia primaria tra i partner di distribuzione e gli stakeholder interni.

• Distributori di supporto nell'impegno del cliente, comprese visite congiunte, presentazioni e trattative.

• Monitorare le prestazioni del distributore, implementare azioni correttive e migliorare continuamente le prestazioni di vendita e la redditività.

• Fornire competenze tecniche in automazione di laboratorio, configurazione degli strumenti e soluzioni integrate.

• Fornire presentazioni tecniche di alto livello e partecipare a discussioni chiave del cliente.

• Coordinate le parti interessate interne interfunzionali per garantire l'esecuzione di progetti complessi e di alto valore.

• Viaggia a lungo (50–70%) nella regione EMEA per supportare il distributore e le esigenze dei clienti.

Il tuo sfondo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di abilità dure: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• Laurea in scienze tecniche o naturali (biologia molecolare, fisica, ingegneria o campi correlati).

• Esperienza di 5+ anni in scienze della vita, diagnostica o automazione di laboratorio, con esposizione pratica a strumenti di laboratorio complessi o piattaforme di automazione.

• Proventa la gestione dei record o il lavoro con le reti di distribuzione (probabilmente attraverso EMEA).

• Forte comprensione dei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio, delle applicazioni e degli ambienti dei clienti.

• Le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese; francese, tedesco o arabo sono un plus.

• Volontà e capacità di viaggiare in modo esteso (50-70%) nella regione EMEA.

• Mindset strategico, resilienza, agilità e un approccio collaborativo per influenzare senza autorità diretta.

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung oder Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebsnetzwerken (idealerweise in EMEA).

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch; Französisch, Deutsch oder Arabisch sind ein Plus.

• Bereitschaft und Fähigkeit, ausgiebig (50-70%) in der EMEA-Region zu reisen.

W Hat macht das Arbeiten bei Tecan einzigartig

Regional Channel Sales & Distributors Manager EMEA (100 %)

Männedorf, Suisse (avec de nombreux voyages à travers l'EMEA)

Votre contribution

En tant que directeur régional des ventes et des distributeurs, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la croissance de Tecan dans toute la région de l'EMEA. Vous serez responsable de la construction et de la gestion d'un réseau de distributeurs performant, assurant à nos partenaires le pouvoir de fournir des solutions d'automatisation de laboratoire avancées aux clients dans les sciences de la vie, les marchés appliqués et les diagnostics cliniques. En agissant comme un lien stratégique entre les besoins du marché et les équipes internes de Tecan, vous aiderez à façonner le développement des entreprises et l'innovation des produits. Vos efforts assureront le positionnement et l'adoption de solutions techniques complexes, tout en favorisant des relations de distributeurs solides et autosuffisantes qui soutiennent la réputation de Tecan pour l'excellence et la satisfaction des clients.

Responsabilités

• Diriger le recrutement, l'embarquement et la gestion continue des performances des partenaires des distributeurs dans l'ensemble de l'EMEA.

• Élaborer et exécuter des plans d'affaires stratégiques avec chaque distributeur, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de croissance de Tecan.

• Posséder le cycle complet des ventes, de la génération des opportunités à la réalisation des projets, en tant qu'interface principale entre les partenaires de distribution et les intervenants internes.

• Soutenir les distributeurs dans l'engagement des clients, y compris les visites conjointes, les présentations et les négociations.

• Surveiller les performances des distributeurs, mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et favoriser l'amélioration continue des performances et de la rentabilité des ventes.

• Fournir une expertise technique en automatisation de laboratoire, configuration des instruments et solutions intégrées.

• Présenter des exposés techniques de haut niveau et participer à des discussions clés avec les clients.

• Coordonner les intervenants internes interfonctionnels afin d'assurer la réussite des projets complexes et de grande valeur.

• Voyagez largement (50 à 70 %) dans toute la région de l'EMEA pour répondre aux besoins des distributeurs et des clients.

Vos antécédents

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement des compétences difficiles: Nous recherchons des personnes qui apportent leur passion et leur talent au travail.

• Diplôme en sciences techniques ou naturelles (biologie moléculaire, physique, génie ou domaines connexes).

• 5+ ans d'expérience en sciences de la vie, diagnostics, ou l'automatisation de laboratoire, avec une exposition pratique à des instruments de laboratoire complexes ou plates-formes d'automatisation.

• Expérience éprouvée en gestion ou en collaboration avec des réseaux de distributeurs (idéalement dans toute l'EMEA).

• Une bonne compréhension des flux de travail en laboratoire, des applications et des environnements clients.

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais; français, allemand ou arabe sont un plus.

• Volonté et capacité de voyager largement (50 à 70 %) dans toute la région de l'EMEA.

• L'état d'esprit stratégique, la résilience, l'agilité et une approche collaborative pour influencer sans autorité directe.

Production Engineer (100%)

Männedorf, Schweiz

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Diventa parte del nostro team di produzione e usa il talento e la passione che ti fa.

Ingegnere di produzione (100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo versatile, assumerai la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la vostra comprensione tecnica e la passione per i sistemi complessi e la spinta per un costante miglioramento, contribuite in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti del cliente. Essi servono come interfaccia tra produzione interna / esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia di qualità.

• Definizione e sviluppo dei processi MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

• implementazione end-to-end e ottimizzazione continua del MES

• Responsabilità per la gestione dei progetti e dei sottoprogetti in complesse implementazioni e rollout MES

• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie zero al phase-out.

• Iniziazione e implementazione di cambiamenti meccanici, elettronici o software insieme a un team di esperti.

• Analisi degli errori e attuazione delle misure di miglioramento

• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni di processo nella nostra produzione o nei fornitori.

• Sviluppo e pianificazione delle attrezzature di produzione e di prova richieste

• Supporto del processo e controllo delle linee di produzione assegnate monitorando i dati chiave

• Garantire la qualità dei dati nel sistema ERP per un trattamento regolare degli ordini

• Partecipazione a progetti LCM per la realizzazione degli aspetti produttivi

• Sostegno all'assicurazione della qualità in materia tecnica

• Sostenere l'acquisto con problemi tecnici e attività con fornitori e subfornitori

Il tuo profilo

• Motivazione e responsabilità personale per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti e processi produttivi.

• Ingegneria (ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria dei sistemi o ingegneria di produzione) o tecnico con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale

• Ottima conoscenza dell'ingegneria di produzione, progettazione e logistica

• Esperienza professionale nel settore della tecnologia medica regolamentata/biofarmacia, automazione, automotive e/o aviazione

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Oltre alle competenze tecniche, stiamo anche cercando una personalità che si distingue per l'azione proattiva e la voglia di un costante miglioramento.

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

· L'opportunità di fare la differenza e modellare il mondo di domani

· Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

· Eccitanti opportunità di carriera

· Cultura aziendale forte e unica

· Compensazione attraente e benefici sociali

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui potete scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo solo considerare le applicazioni che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Motion Control Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this challenging and impactful role, you will be at the forefront of designing, implementing, and testing advanced drive chain concepts and sensing applications for existing- and our next-generation robotic and automation platforms. You will lead the evaluation, collaborate closely with the embedded software, mechanical and electrical specialists, and ensure the performance, reliability, and robustness of our solutions. As a technical mentor and coach, you will support and guide other engineers, contribute to cross-project consistency, and drive continuous improvement in our processes and best practices. Your expertise will help shape the future of healthcare innovation.

Responsibilities

• Lead drive concept evaluation, including different actor and sensor types, transmission, and initialization procedures

• Perform motor dimensioning, work point calculation, and simulation

• Review and refine robotic and automation concepts

• Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software/system architects

• Develop and improve internal control tools and processes

• Lead root cause investigations and risk assessments

• Mentor and coach engineers, apprentices, trainees, and students

• Initiate collaborations with academia and external partners

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, directives, and guidelines

• Contribute to the system-wide platform strategy

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Technical degree in computer science, robotics, control technology, electrical or software engineering

• 6+ years of experience in instrument development, preferably in the medical device industry

• Expertise in motion control, robotics, control theory, and signal processing

• Experience with scientific programming; knowledge of C++, C#, Python or

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and research skills

• Demonstrated experience in leading teams and assuming technical ownership of projects, ensuring successful delivery and high-quality outcomes

• Excellent communication and moderation skills in English, German would be a nice to have

• Experience with agile principles and R&D development processes

• Passion for continuous learning and improvement

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

Haben Sie sich jemals gefragt, wie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen könnten? Treten Sie unserem Produktmanagement-Team bei und bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihr Talent in die Arbeit.

Head Software Product Management - Lab Automation & Liquid Handling (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Ihr Beitrag

In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle innerhalb unseres Produktmanagement-Teams werden Sie Tecans Softwarestrategie für unser Produktportfolio im Liquid Handling definieren und vorantreiben. Als Head of Software Product Management verbinden Sie Produktmanagement und F&E und stellen sicher, dass Architektur- und Produktentscheidungen sowohl den Kundenbedürfnissen als auch den Geschäftszielen dienen. Sie bauen, entwickeln und leiten ein leistungsstarkes Software-Produktmanagement-Team, das sich für eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Integration und Rechenschaftspflicht einsetzt.

Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Transformation spielen - Veränderung führen, Menschen entwickeln und kritische Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Einstellung, Teamstruktur und Leistungsmanagement treffen. Ihre Fähigkeit, auszuführen, eine klare Richtung festzulegen und messbare Ergebnisse zu liefern, ist von entscheidender Bedeutung, wenn Sie die Verbesserung der Plattform vorantreiben und sicherstellen, dass unsere Softwareprodukte die höchsten Qualitäts- und Compliance-Standards erfüllen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Führen, entwickeln und behalten Sie ein leistungsstarkes Software-Produktmanagement-Team durch klare Leitung, Coaching und Nachfolgeplanung.

• Fördern Sie eine kollaborative, integrative und verantwortungsbewusste Teamkultur.

• Champion Customer Insight und Wettbewerbsbewusstsein als Grundlage für alle Software-Produktentscheidungen.

• Fahren Sie Tecans Softwarestrategie und Produkt-Roadmap voran und balancieren Sie die kurzfristige Lieferung mit der langfristigen Plattformgesundheit.

• Dienen Sie als dediziertes Produkt-Pendant für Software-Architektur innerhalb von F & E, um sicherzustellen, dass geschäftsdefinierte Anforderungen erfüllt werden.

• Dienen Sie als Produktstimme bei architektonischen Entscheidungen über alle Softwareebenen hinweg und stellen Sie sicher, dass Kontrolle, Orchestrierung, Middleware, Anwendungen und Integrationen mit geschäftsdefinierten Anforderungen übereinstimmen

• Lead Build vs. Buy vs. Partnerbewertungen für Softwarekomponenten und Plattformfähigkeiten.

Dein Hintergrund

Wir suchen nicht nur nach Hard Skills: Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent in die Arbeit bringen.

• Ein Abschluss in Software / Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss oder MBA ist ein Plus.

• 5–7+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, idealerweise in den Bereichen Life Sciences, Diagnostik, Medizinprodukte oder Hardware.

• Starke Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Einstellung, Entwicklung und Management von Teams.

• Erfahrung mit Laborinformatik-Ökosystemen (LIMS, ELN, Integrationsstandards wie SiLA2, OPC-UA oder ähnliches).

• Tiefes technisches Verständnis von APIs, verteilten Systemen, Middleware, Orchestrierung und eingebetteten Systemen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Englisch; Deutsch oder andere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Strategisches Denken kombiniert mit praktischer Ausführung und einer zielorientierten Denkweise.

• Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden und modernen Softwareentwicklungspraktiken.

• Kenntnis der regulatorischen und Qualitätsstandards (z. B. ISO, FDA, DSGVO).

• Bereitschaft, bei Bedarf international zu reisen.

W Hat macht das Arbeiten bei Tecan einzigartig

Die Chance, dass es zählt und einen Einfluss auf die Welt von morgen hat

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Die Chance, Ihre Karriere innerhalb des Unternehmens zu erweitern

• Fühlen Sie sich durch unsere starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur gestärkt

• Umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket

Treten Sie Tecan bei, einem großartigen Ort zum Arbeiten! Lesen Sie mehr über unsere jüngste Zertifizierung von Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung online. Bitte reichen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf oder Lebenslauf ein (mit Bild und Anschreiben, Referenzschreiben und Diplomen sind optional).

Unser Ziel.

Bei Tecan sind wir bestrebt, das Leben und die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir tun dies, indem wir unsere Kunden in die Lage versetzen, Gesundheitsinnovationen weltweit von der Biowissenschaft bis zur Klinik zu skalieren. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden von der Frühphase der Innovation bis zur Projektumsetzung und darüber hinaus zusammen. Wir liefern die Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die Laborprozesse und medizinische Verfahren präzise, reproduzierbar und konform machen.

Bleib einzigartig und lass es zählen.

Unsere Werte - Vertrauen, höchste Standards und Ehrgeiz - sind die Eckpfeiler unseres Geschäfts und bilden den Rahmen für die Kultur von Tecan. Wir fördern ein positives und ermächtigendes Umfeld, in dem unsere seltensten Vermögenswerte, unsere einzigartigen Mitarbeiter, wachsen und ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent einbringen können.

Gestion des produits de Head Software - Automatisation des laboratoires et manipulation des liquides (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Votre contribution

Dans ce rôle de leader central au sein de notre équipe de gestion de produits, vous définirez et piloterez la stratégie logicielle Tecans pour notre portefeuille de produits de manutention de liquides. En tant que chef de la gestion des produits logiciels, vous établirez un lien entre la gestion des produits et la R-D, en veillant à ce que les décisions en matière d'architecture et de produits répondent aux besoins des clients et aux objectifs opérationnels. Vous créerez, développerez et dirigerez une équipe de gestion des produits logiciels hautement performante, défendant une culture de collaboration, d'inclusion et de responsabilité.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la transformation : diriger le changement, former des gens et prendre des décisions cruciales en matière d'embauche, de structure d'équipe et de gestion du rendement. Votre capacité d'exécuter, de définir une direction claire et de fournir des résultats mesurables sera essentielle car vous conduisez des améliorations de plate-forme et assurez que nos produits logiciels répondent aux normes les plus élevées de qualité et de conformité.

Responsabilités

• Diriger, développer et conserver une équipe de gestion de produits logiciels hautement performante grâce à une direction claire, un encadrement et une planification de la relève.

• Favoriser une culture d'équipe collaborative, inclusive et hautement responsable.

• Compréhension des clients champions et sensibilisation concurrentielle comme base pour toutes les décisions de produits logiciels.

• Diriger la stratégie logicielle et la feuille de route des produits de Tecan, en conciliant la prestation à court terme et la santé à long terme des plateformes.

• Servir d'équivalent de produit dédié à l'architecture de logiciels dans la R-D, en veillant à ce que les exigences définies par les entreprises soient respectées.

• Servir de voix de produit dans les décisions architecturales de toutes les couches de logiciels, en assurant le contrôle, l'orchestration, le middleware, les applications et les intégrations conformes aux exigences définies par les entreprises

• Lead build vs. buy vs. partner évaluations pour les composants logiciels et les capacités de plate-forme.

Vos antécédents

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement des compétences difficiles: Nous recherchons des gens qui apportent leur passion et leur talent au travail.

• Un diplôme en logiciel / informatique, en génie, ou un domaine technique connexe; un diplôme avancé ou MBA est un plus.

• 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits, idéalement dans les sciences de la vie, les diagnostics, les matériels médicaux ou les industries liées au matériel.

• Forte expérience en leadership, y compris l'embauche, le développement et la gestion d'équipes.

• Expérience des écosystèmes informatiques de laboratoire (LIMS, ELN, normes d'intégration telles que SiLA2, OPC-UA, ou similaire).

• Compréhension technique approfondie des API, des systèmes distribués, des intergiciels, de l'orchestration et des systèmes embarqués.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation en anglais; l'allemand ou d'autres langues sont un plus.

• La pensée stratégique combinée avec l'exécution pratique et un état d'esprit orienté vers l'objectif.

• Expérience des méthodologies Agiles et des pratiques modernes de développement de logiciels.

• Connaissance des normes de réglementation et de qualité (p. ex. ISO, FDA, RGPD).

• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger au besoin.

W chapeau rend travailler à Tecan unique

La chance de le faire compter et d'avoir un impact sur le monde de demain

• Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié

• La chance de développer votre carrière au sein de l'entreprise

• Se sentir autonomisé par notre culture d'entreprise forte et unique

• Ensemble complet de rémunération et de prestations

Rejoignez Tecan, un excellent endroit pour travailler ! Lisez notre récente certification de Great Place to Work .

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande en ligne. Veuillez soumettre votre CV ou votre curriculum vitae (w/o photo et w/o lettre de motivation, lettres de référence et diplômes sont facultatifs).

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

(Associate) Customer Product Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Customer Product Manager, you will be the primary liaison for coordinating and driving our Partnering Business partner products — with a special focus on customized solutions based on platform products— with all internal and external stakeholders. You will support the Partnering Business sales teams in contractual and pricing negotiations, outline value propositions, and drive alignment sessions. Your role involves managing trade-offs between client business demands, product life cycle stages, and Tecan business needs to create win/win positions. You will also contribute to the development of the Customer Product Management team with entrepreneurial thinking and market insights.

Responsibilities

• Manage and oversee all day-to-day lifecycle and operational aspects for assigned projects and products, including business and quality review meetings, regular conference calls, and product change management.

• Drive customer satisfaction and support Tecan’s Partnering Business marketing, financial, and growth objectives through operational excellence and proactive life cycle management.

• Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and maintain relevant product documentation.

• Monitor and manage product forecasting, orders, and deliveries, and drive necessary actions in alignment with key stakeholders.

• Lead the Product Care Team, manage product-related KPIs, and ensure on-time delivery of agreed items.

• Support the sales organization in preparing and negotiating contracts, and monitor contract expirations and obligations.

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and spot and identify client trends.

• Play a key role in efficiently managing the lifecycle of platform-based products by applying established processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering, with further education in Product Management or Business Administration.

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life science business.

• Experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and product/lifecycle management.

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in executing complex contracts.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations.

• Team-oriented, entrepreneurial thinking, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated.

• Willingness to travel worldwide (5-10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

(Associate) Product Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di Customer Product Manager, sarai il principale collegamento per il coordinamento e la guida dei nostri prodotti partner Partnering Business, con un focus particolare sulle soluzioni personalizzate basate sui prodotti della piattaforma, con tutti gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Sosterrai i team di vendita Partnering Business nei negoziati contrattuali e sui prezzi, tratterà le proposizioni di valore e le sessioni di allineamento dei drive. Il tuo ruolo consiste nella gestione dei trade-off tra le esigenze aziendali dei clienti, le fasi del ciclo di vita dei prodotti e le esigenze aziendali Tecan per creare posizioni vincenti/win. Contribuirai anche allo sviluppo del team Customer Product Management con il pensiero imprenditoriale e le intuizioni di mercato.

responsabilità

• Gestire e supervisionare tutto il ciclo di vita quotidiano e gli aspetti operativi per progetti e prodotti assegnati, tra cui riunioni di revisione aziendale e di qualità, telefonate di conferenza regolari e gestione del cambiamento di prodotto.

• Guidare la soddisfazione del cliente e sostenere gli obiettivi di marketing, finanza e crescita di Tecan Partnering Business attraverso l'eccellenza operativa e la gestione proattiva del ciclo di vita.

• Assicurare la conformità a tutti i requisiti normativi applicabili e mantenere la documentazione relativa del prodotto.

• Monitorare e gestire le previsioni, gli ordini e le consegne dei prodotti e guidare le azioni necessarie in allineamento con i principali stakeholder.

• Guidare il team di cura del prodotto, gestire i KPI relativi al prodotto e garantire la consegna in tempo reale degli articoli concordati.

• Sostenere l'organizzazione delle vendite nella preparazione e nella negoziazione dei contratti e monitorare le scadenze e gli obblighi contrattuali.

• Fornire guida e supporto interfunzionali per le squadre, e individuare e identificare le tendenze dei clienti.

• Svolgere un ruolo chiave nella gestione efficiente del ciclo di vita dei prodotti basati sulla piattaforma applicando processi consolidati e promuovendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo

Il tuo sfondo

Non stiamo solo cercando competenze difficili: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• Laurea in Chimica, Biologia, Medicina o Ingegneria, con ulteriore formazione nella gestione dei prodotti o Business Administration.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei liquidi e robotica, diagnostica clinica e/o scienza della vita.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di sistemi altamente complessi, supporto alle attività di vendita di sistemi e gestione del prodotto/ciclo.

• La competenza in inglese; il tedesco sarebbe un bene.

• Forte capacità di negoziazione ed esperienza nell'esecuzione di contratti complessi.

• Alta autorità naturale, potere di persuasione, e capacità di gestire le situazioni di mercato e cliente in rapida evoluzione.

• Il pensiero imprenditoriale, orientato al team, persistente, affidabile e motivato.

• Volontà di viaggiare in tutto il mondo (5-10%).

Cappello W fa lavorare a Tecan unico

La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.
